rows.description: Hit your Claude Code usage limit or ran out of credits? Keep working on a local model. Claude Code on your own Mac (MLX), Linux or Windows (llama.cpp) with no API key and no rate limits. Your code stays home.

Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Up to 4× faster than Apple's MLX (mlx-lm) on the same weights.
The native UI for Apple Containers and (o)MLX sandboxes, written in swift as a replacement for docker desktop
